corrections.reason: The printed Fidel is 1st-order አ ('አራት ኅብር' = four colors/types, followed by 'አምስተኛ' = fifth), which was misread as 6th-order እ due to slight ink wear.
Both visually (the right-side 2nd-order vowel mark on ኁ) and grammatically in Ge'ez (3rd person masculine plural matching ርእዩ and ወይቤሉ), the verb is ወጸርኁ ('and they cried out').
The printed glyph has the 2nd-order stroke of ኁ (ወይጸርኁ, 3rd person plural matching ወይበክይዋ, ወይላሕውዋ, ወይብሉ, rendered in Amharic L27-28 as እየጮሁ).
Joined across the line wrap with L34 ስዮን ፡ ጋቤር, the biblical port where King Solomon built ships (1 Kings 9:26) is በዓስዮን ፡ ጋቤር (Ezion-geber); the final character on L33 is ዓ, not ጋ.
